The notes backend is in `supabase/migrations/20261116000000_notes.sql`. I haven't run it or the generated access tests, because no local Supabase was running.

- **Table:** `note` has `id` (uuid primary key, generated), `owner` (uuid, required, references `auth.users`) and `body` (text, required). There is an index on `owner`.
- **Who sees and changes what:** row-level security is on. Signed-in people can read, create, edit and delete only rows where `owner` is their own id. Creating or editing a note can't set `owner` to someone else. Anonymous visitors get nothing.
